text.content:
Factories, power plants, and the people who work them.

Region: Night City, east
Controlled by: The megacorps that own the factories; 6th Street on the streets
Feel: Sprawl, smog, and constant construction
Notable locations: Arroyo: Arasaka Industrial Park, Dewdrop Inn, Night City Prison, Red Dirt (an early Samurai venue). Rancho Coronado: Coronado Dam, Night City Center for Psychiatric Health, Rancho Coronado Public High School, Tripple Xtreme Epic Workout Center

Refugees fled here from central Night City during the 4th Corporate War, and the nomads who came to rebuild camped here too. The megacorps built factories on the cheap land, and today power plants and factories sit among run-down homes.

Arroyo is always under construction as automated factories retool for whatever the corps want next. Rancho Coronado is the corporate suburb built to house the workers, slowly falling apart around them.

Gig hooks

  • The Dewdrop Inn's night manager hides people for a price. Someone just paid a lot more to find one.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.19
